newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - FTSE index options busy as shares fall.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - FTSE index options busy as shares fall.

text.p: FTSE 100 index options dominated activity in UK equity options on Thursday ahead of tomorrow's March index futures and options expiry, dealers said.

Most deals concerned rolling-out or closing positions in the March series. Outside of that, in European style FTSE one of the larger trades by early afternoon was a long straddle, which was hedged by FTSE futures in a volatility trade.
The straddle consisted of the purchase of 1,500 April 4325 puts and calls at 50p and 73p each, making a net debit of 123p which was hedged by March futures at 4300.
If properly hedged, increased market volatility will help make this trade make a profit.
By 1348 GMT, spot FTSE was down 38.7 to 4293.5 and March futures were down 33 at 4298.
There was interest also in the June options series for FTSE with traders buying volatility by purchasing puts or calls.

Such traders speculated that a Labour party victory at the forthcoming May 1 election will mean the new government will produce or announce intentions of a budget a few weeks later and that these events will generate further market volatility, one dealer said.

Over in stock options, the main trade in British Steel was from a seller of 1,500 April 140 calls at 20p. Because these options have very little time value -- about 1/4p -- dealers believed this was a closing position.
In British Telecommunications one large deal was to buy 500 November 500 calls at 15-1/2p. BT shares were unchanged at 461-1/2p.
